record.context_brief: Logistic competition second boundary fixed point
record.original_question: Consider the logistic competition system x_{n+1}=a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1}=b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x,y∈[0,1], c,d∈(0,1), and a,b∈(0,4]. Determine the stability type of the boundary fixed point (0,(b-1)/b) in the parameter case b=3 and a=1+c(b-1)/b.

evidence.quote: In [1], the authors considered the following logistic competition model: x_{n+1} = a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1} = b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x, y ∈ [0,1], c, d ∈ (0,1) and a, b ∈ (0,4].
Open problem 2.5. (2) Determine the stability of the fixed point (0,(b-1)/b) of equation (3) if b = 3 and a = 1 + (c(b-1)/b).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the planar discrete-time logistic competition system
   x_{n+1} = a x_n (1 - x_n) / (1 + c y_n),
   y_{n+1} = b y_n (1 - y_n) / (1 + d x_n),
with state space (x_n, y_n) ∈ [0,1]×[0,1] and parameters c, d ∈ (0,1), a, b ∈ (0,4]. The point (0, (b-1)/b) is a boundary fixed point of this map (lying on the y-axis) whenever b > 1.

Specialize to the parameter regime
   b = 3,    a = 1 + c(b-1)/b = 1 + 2c/3,
with c, d ∈ (0,1) arbitrary. In this critical case the standard linearization at (0, (b-1)/b) becomes non-hyperbolic (one eigenvalue equals 1, the other equals -1, the latter coming from b = 3 at the logistic fixed point (b-1)/b).

Determine the stability type of the fixed point (0, (b-1)/b) of the above system for all c, d ∈ (0,1) in this critical case: is it (Lyapunov) stable, asymptotically stable, or unstable, and characterize the local dynamics (e.g., center-manifold behavior, period-doubling, etc.) near this point in terms of c and d.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem about the stability of a non-hyperbolic boundary fixed point in a discrete logistic competition system. No published resolution was located.
